label.purpose: Mono metadata, nav, stacks, company names, footer meta.

motion.name: transition-colors
motion.purpose: Hover and current-state colour changes on links, rows and chips.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA: solid lime block with ink text, used for View work and the header-adjacent actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action with a 1px Paper border, used for Contact.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { color: hsl(var(--primary)); border-color: hsl(var(--primary)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Case File Row
components.description: Full-width case link; fills lime on hover and inverts its text.

Rock in Rio purchase flow

Ticket purchase flow rebuilt for Ingresso.com.

Ingresso.com
components.css: .ds-case { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1.5rem 2rem; padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-case:hover, .ds-case:focus-visible { background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); } .ds-case:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--foreground)); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-case-title { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem); line-height: 1.05; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-case-desc { margin: 1rem 0 0; max-width: 36rem; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.5; color: hsl(60 2% 63%); } .ds-case:hover .ds-case-desc, .ds-case:focus-visible .ds-case-desc { color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); } .ds-case-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin: 1.25rem 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-case-company { flex: 1 1 11rem; margin: 0.25rem 0 0; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: hsl(var(--primary)); } .ds-case:hover .ds-case-company, .ds-case:focus-visible .ds-case-company { color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); } .ds-chip { border: 1px solid hsl(240 4% 17%); padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: hsl(60 2% 63%); list-style: none; } .ds-case:hover .ds-chip, .ds-case:focus-visible .ds-chip { border-color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Stack tag: 1px rule border, mono label.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid hsl(240 4% 17%); padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: hsl(60 2% 63%); border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Contact drawer field: transparent, 1px rule stroke, lime focus border.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: 1px solid hsl(240 4% 17%); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; color: hsl(60 9% 92%); outline: none; border-radius: 0; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: hsl(74 100% 61%); }

components.name: Header Nav Link
components.description: Mono uppercase nav item with a bracketed shortcut key; lime when current or hovered.
components.css: .ds-nav { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav:hover, .ds-nav[aria-current="page"] { color: hsl(var(--primary)); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Skills Band
components.description: Full-width lime strip of uppercase mono skills, separated by pipes.
components.css: .ds-band { background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); padding: 1rem 0; overflow: hidden; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-band-list { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 1rem; list-style: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-band-list li { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-band-list li:not(:last-child)::after { content: '|'; }

narrative.overview: The site reads as a case file kept in the dark. Near-black surfaces, hairline rules and monospace metadata set the frame, and one acid lime signal marks only what the visitor should act on or read first. The personality is direct and technical. Nothing is rounded, nothing glows, and the headline does the work that imagery would do on other portfolios.
keyCharacteristics: Dark near-black field with off-white text and a single lime accent.
Square geometry: every radius token resolves to 0.
Hairline rules divide content; surfaces stay flat.
Monospace for metadata, grotesk for everything a visitor reads as copy.

rules.name: The Single Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime marks action and emphasis only: the CTA, the headline accent, current navigation, the skills band and the hovered case row. It never becomes body colour or a second accent.

rules.name: The Mono Evidence Rule
rules.body: Metadata, labels and proof tags are set in JetBrains Mono. Grotesk carries claims; mono carries the facts about them.

dos: Do keep every radius at 0px; the token resolves to zero.
Do reserve Acid Lime for the roles listed in the Single Signal Rule.
Do set metadata and labels in JetBrains Mono.
Do separate sections with 1px Rule borders rather than cards or shadows.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour; the lime is the only accent in the code.
Don't introduce rounded corners on buttons, chips, inputs or rows.
Don't use Alert Red as text on Ink Black at its current lightness; it is low contrast and needs a lighter value before it is used for error copy.
